notes.title: Patch 14.0 - Chapter 5 (Final)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36075912/b9581ae314375aa58aee815b9d1c059233ec55c6.png[/img]
[h1][b]Updated Features:[/b][/h1]

- Story Mode completed: Now it is possible to end Story Mode with Chapter 5 (Final)! .
- New Areas: Besides the new Chapter 5's areas and scenes, new stores are now available in the Sky and Sun villages.
- Fishing Improved: Fishing Skill Levels introduced, fishing becomes easier and more rewarding with each level. Fixed a bug where fishing wouldn't work as it should. 
- New Missions: Talk to people in each village to check if they can give you a mission. 
- Mazes Improved: Now Magical Mazes have fairer goals. 
- New Achievements: [i]Legends Never Die[/i], [i]Rich Girl[/i], [i]Gotta List 'em All[/i], [i]Birch Valley[/i], [i]Is This Really Right?[/i] and [i]Outta My Way![/i]
- New Visual and Mechanical Enhancements: New HUD with more information and utility buttons on screen for easier access to some features, such as saving progress and game manual. 
- Performance improved using less space: Game's files have been worked on for a better expernce and better framerate in all configurations, especially the low-end ones. The game now uses less storage space.
- Texts and translations improved.
- Several bugs fixed. 
P.S.: These updates were progressively applied throughout patches 13.1, 13.2, 13.3, 13.4, 13.5, 13.6, 13.7, 13.8, 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 & 14.0.

notes.title: Patch 13.0 - Expansion 4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36075912/b9581ae314375aa58aee815b9d1c059233ec55c6.png[/img]
[h1][b]Updated Features:[/b][/h1]

- Chapter 4 complete: Now it is possible to end Chapter 4 on Story Mode.
- New Feature: Now Gabriela, Mikhail and Gav can learn new skills by using skills they already have lots of times and/or meeting certain conditions. Using a variety of skills results in more new skills being learned. For example, using Gav's "Combo of Punches" and his "Fire Punch" many times will make him learn "Flaming Combo". Even more new skills will be added in future patches.
- New Feature: Overkill. If you deal excessive damage when defeating an enemy, you'll be rewarded with more experience, gold and items. An animation will let you now you did it successfully.
- New Feature: Tips and Visual Aid - Now when starting a new game, you're able to select whether you want tips and visual aid for an easier gaming experience or not. This option is also available in your Game Manual.
- New Areas: New stores are now available in the Sky, Sun and Blossom villages. The Sky Village now has a taxi stand too, and it is possible to have taxi stands and other types of fast travel in other villages too by completing missions.
- Fishing improved: Now it is possible to go fishing in every accessible river, lake and cave. Fishing rods and baits are now availble for sale sooner in the game. Look for them in the Gravel, Sky or Rain Villages.
- New achievements: [i]Exceptional Evolution[/i], [i]I can do it too![/i], [i]Who's the best?[/i], [i]How many were they again?[/i], [i]Fishing Beginner[/i], [i]Fishing Supreme Master[/i], [i]As if we didn't have enough to worry about...[/i] (updated) and [i]I work for nobody![/i]
- New Visual and Mechanical Enhacements: Title Screen, Mode Selection Screen and Chapters 1, 2, 3 and 4 have suffered various visual and mechanical enhacements for a better gaming experience
- Performance improved: Game's structure has been worked on for a better experience and better framerate in all configurations, especially the low-end ones. Performance in the Eternal Ice Mountain (Chapter 3+) has been particularly prioritized for enhacements.
- Texts and translations improved.
- Several bugs fixed. Important: One of the cutscenes on Chapter 2 will no longer crash the game. Now the Rain Village's tournament is working properly. Achievements now are working properly.

P.S.: These updates were progressively applied throughout patches 12.2, 12.3, 12.4, 12.5, 12.6, 12.7, 12.8, 12.9, 12.10, 12.11, 12.12, 12.13 and 13.0.

notes.title: Update 10: Expansion 2 - Fishing, New Equipment and more...
notes.content:
This patch is part of a series of expansions and adjustments to the currently available chapters.

Updated resources:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36075912/a06b3e28a3759e7855d661ecbf5c49f1b483d6a6.png[/img]


- New Feature: Now you can go fishing! Head for the Rain Village and talk to Marcus to start your fishing journey! You can find 15 fish and many other items while fishing. Earn XP, learn new recipes and sell what you fish to earn more money!
- New Feature: Now you can sew and create some equipment! Talk to the Armohere's staff in the Sky Village to get their missions!
- New Feature: Now you can forge Level 30 Legendary Equipment and Weapons in the Damnation Palace! Level up and equip yourself to face enemies stronger than ever before!
- New Feature: The Rain Tournament - Fight powerful mages, from all the protected villages, including the Mystic Warriors, study strategies to defeat new and known opponents to get the master prize! Go to [i]Maraxes[/i] in the Rain Village to join the tournament.
- New areas: You can now access [i]Marcus the Fishmonger[/i], [i]Theodore the Apothecary[/i], and the equipment shop [i]Maraxes[/i]. Find the Discount Coupons for all these new stores in the Rain Village!
- Tons of new equipment and weapons: Aside from the Legendary Equipment and Weapons from the Damnation Palace, you can find new common equipment and weapons for the levels 20-29 at [i]Maraxes[/i], in the Rain Village
- New missions: New and old people are giving off missions in the Rain Village. Check all of them out!
- 10+ new enemies. Defeat them and add them to the Bestiary
- New books were added to the Library of the Waters, in the Rain Village
- New Unlockable Characters for Battle Mode: Stella, Dolores, Milena, Carol, Kelly, Paula, Karen, Edna, Tamra, Quinton, Viktor and Kevin
- Now the Battle Mode has 70 characters. Therefore, the [i]"We're halfway there"[/i] achievement has been adjusted
- New unlockable skins: Fisherwoman Gabriela, Underworld Aurora, Tournament Gabriela, Tournament Stella, Tournament Jackson, Tournament Natasha, Tournament Philip, Tournament Sue
- New animations and visual effects
- General balancing, adjusting and renaming to some items, equipments, weapons and skills. 
-  Improved texts and translations. In case you find untranslated text, get in touch via Steam Discussions or e-mail: auroramidiagames@gmail.com.
- Several bugs fixed

A note from Zoe: 

"Huge thanks to Vitor Rubião and Cristina Jadi Martins who gave me strength and helped me with translating and advising! <3 

Thanks again and remember to comment and leave a review!

See you!"

Aurora - Hidden Colors is now on sale. Don't lose the chance:

notes.title: Update 4: Battle Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36075912/a06b3e28a3759e7855d661ecbf5c49f1b483d6a6.png[/img]

[b]Early Access[/b]
Aurora - Hidden Colors is in Early Access. This means the game is still in development, it's not in its final version. Therefore only a part of the final game is available. In Aurora's case, we have the 1st chapter of the Story Mode, the 1st chapter of the Adventure Mode (very similar to Story Mode's), and 2 submodes of Battle Mode: Arcade and VS Raid. Errors may be found and must be reported for us to correct them. If you find any issues when playing Aurora - Hidden Colors, get in touch via auroramidiagames@gmail.com or Steam Discussions.

[b]Battle Mode available[/b]
28 playable characters can be unlocked by playing the Battle Mode, and in the future other 32 will be added. Characters will only be unlocked through the Story and Adventure modes.

[b]Balancing[/b]
Initial balancing configured. Throughout the week, small updates may occur to solve problems with unbeatable characters or characters who can't defeat any oppnent. We've opted for weaker and less intelligent enemies to start off, so everyone has a chance to explore the Arcade Mode. We'll keep an eye on characters who need balancing, and we'll realize further updating. Our intention is to raise the difficulty of the battles and add new game modes to please all kinds of players.

[b]Arcade[/b]
As a good fighting game, the Battle Mode allows you to face series of enemies with Arcade Mode. There are 7 rivals (randomly select from a 41-character pool) and two bosses (Anastasia and Igor). You can unlock a new character at the end. Most characters may unlock a new different character if you finish the Arcade mode with them. Only 28 characters are currently available as playable. All ways of unlocking them can be checked out by selecting their sillhouettes on the character selection screen. Our goal is to have 60 playable characters. New characters will be gradually released to be unlocked on Battle, Story and Adventure modes.

[b]VS Raid[/b]
The first (local) multiplayer mode is available. Due to technical difficulties related to the game's engine, when playing the VS Raid mode, all players control the game as they wish. Therefore, we recommend you to organize yourselves and respect your mates to avoid attempts to cheat. We'll think of a way for each gamepad to control the game only when it's its turn, but IF we're able to do that, that might not happen anytime soon.

[b]Dear Linux players[/b]
We reinforce again the we have not abandoned the platform. We're working together with Valve and volunteer Linux players to acknowledge and solve the problem that prevents the good functioning of the Linux version of Aurora - Hidden Colors. We ask you to have patience, because soon the game will be available for you on its latest version.

[b]About the Story Mode[/b]
We're working on the continuation of the Story Mode. To guarantee good quality of the story we want to offer, it's taking more time than we wished it was, and with the Battle Mode released, the Story Mode had been on background. However now that the Battle Mode has been launched and it only needs balancing, translating and error corrections, we can go back to focusing on the Story Mode, which is what we'll focus on until we have the 10 initial chapters.

[b]About the Adventure Mode[/b]
The Adventure Mode will be the biggest, the most explorable, the most customizable and completely about how YOU want to play. However, for us to offer all of that, we need time, a lot of time. Therefore we'll prepare an update in order for there to be a conclusion to the Chapter 1 and for players to be able to explore Chapter 2, but after that we'll focus on finishing the Story Mode. After the conclusion of Story Mode, we'll be working flat out on the development of Adventure Mode.

[b]About languages and translations[/b]
The new Battle Mode is 100% available in Portuguese, but not in English. Translating the whole database, the messages, dialogues, skills, menus and everything else takes almost the same amount of time as to developing them. It requires tons of testing and corrections, and for that reason we not always have a respectable translation for all moments in the game. We keep working to correct flaws and procede with the translation of everything that is still not in English. We intend to add Spanish in the future, but we still don't know when. New languages will most probably only be added after the conclusion of the Story Mode.

[b]Your feedback is essential[/b]
In case you play Aurora - Hidden Colors, tell us your opinion about it! Suggestions, comments and complaints are welcome. In case you find any problems, we need to know to solve it ASAP. Get in touch via Steam Discussions or e-mail: auroramidiagames@gmail.com. We're also present on [url=https://www.facebook.com/auroramidia/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/AuroraMidia]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/auroramidiagames/]Instagram[/url].
After finishing the 1st Chapter of the Story Mode, remember to leave a review telling your opinion about it. All feedback is welcome.
Thank you!
